pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
name: Fresno
registryBasis: Fresno County Assessor and GIS sources document parcel mapping and a public county parcel FeatureServer. Its layer schema exposes APN and geometry without owner/address fields; the exact WUP locator intersects one full polygon. This establishes county GIS coverage at the locator, not citywide completeness or legal-survey accuracy.
scopeLimits: 106 valid distinct county parcel polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Fresno WUP settlement locator. Source-native string apn values are preserved unchanged; fid is used only for transport paging. Complete bounded paging, forced three-row pages, all 106 fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 25 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32611 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The original exact-point sample matches fresh full geometry unchanged. Native source CRS is EPSG:3857 (ArcGIS WKID102100); requested EPSG:4326 output is retained unchanged. County parcel reference identity is established; citywide completeness, survey accuracy, legal title, currentness and long-term identity continuity remain unverified.

officialSources.observation: Official Fresno County Assessor mapping page describes APNs as real-property identifiers and links GIS parcel resources.
Official Fresno County GIS portal catalogs public hosted parcel GIS data.
Public ArcGIS layer metadata returned HTTP 200 and identifies a polygon layer with safe APN and geometry fields; owner/address data were not requested.
Exact WUP-point query returned HTTP 200 with one full polygon and APN 43614106. Geometry is retained separately without service attributes.
